text.name: 2.0/Display
text.description: Use once per tab root for the screen greeting or title, such as Good afternoon.

text.name: 2.0/Title
text.description: Use for the main heading of a screen, below the top bar.

text.name: 2.0/Heading
text.description: Use for card titles that lead a story, such as a mode name or a week.

text.name: 2.0/Subheading
text.description: Use for section headings and card titles.

text.name: 2.0/Body
text.description: Use for running text. The default for any paragraph.

text.name: 2.0/Body strong
text.description: Use for list titles and emphasised lines in body text.

text.name: 2.0/Body small
text.description: Use for supporting text in cards and lists.

text.name: 2.0/Label
text.description: Use for form labels, chips and segmented controls.

text.name: 2.0/Caption
text.description: Use for hints, helper text and metadata.

text.name: 2.0/Caption strong
text.description: Use for small status text, such as step counters and badges.

text.name: 2.0/Overline
text.description: Use for short uppercase labels above a group, such as Input and Rule. Avoid for more than two words.

text.name: 2.0/Number L
text.description: Use for a single headline number.

text.name: 2.0/Number M
text.description: Use for numbers in stat tiles and range bars.

text.name: 2.0/Tab
text.description: Use for tab bar labels only.
